title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Shipper's Signed Gross Weight Amendment
content:
## Capability

For Dangerous Goods Acceptance, `sign_amended_dg_declaration_eb5287cf` is the action by which the shipper signs an amended declaration that changes the declared gross weight of one acceptance. A single run files a new amendment declaration for that acceptance, marked as signed by the shipper and repeating the UN number, class and packing group already declared, and it replaces the gross weight on the acceptance with the figure the shipper signed. Afterwards the acceptance shows the new gross weight, and its declaration file lists the signed amendment under a declaration reference of its own. The action changes the gross weight only.

## Who runs it and how

Only the shipper can sign its own declaration, so this action belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it for the customer with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, and the customer themselves then carries it out; the agent does not run it in the customer's place.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dg_id` | reference of the dangerous-goods acceptance being amended, as the acceptance lookup for the customer's booking shows it | identifier |
| `customer_id` | customer reference of the shipper signing the amendment, as the customer profile lookup returns it | identifier |
| `booking_id` | reference of the booking under which the goods travel, as on the acceptance record and in the booking lookup | identifier |
| `vessel_voyage` | the sailing the booking is currently allocated to (vessel name and voyage number), copied exactly as the booking lookup shows it | identifier |
| `gross_weight_kg` | the new total gross weight of the dangerous goods the shipper signs for; it takes the place of the weight declared so far | kilograms, one decimal place |

## Receipt

The run has succeeded when the receipt reports the outcome signed together with the new declaration reference. The receipt contains `submission_id` (reference of the new signed amendment declaration), `dg_id` (the acceptance amended), `gross_weight_kg` (the declared gross weight now on the acceptance, to one decimal place) and `outcome`, which reads `signed` whenever the amendment was filed.
